1

Lord of Mysteries

  • Watch Episode 1 
  • Optional Old Neil's Mysticism Class 
    • You should watch each of these episodes after the corresponding episode of the first season, not before. So Episode 1 of Old Neil should be watched after Episode 1 of Lord of Mysteries, and so forth, up to Episode 8th.
    • These episodes complement what you saw in each of the episodes of the first season, augmenting your understanding of the world and how things work.
    • They are not essential, but unless you are very familiar with the Tarot, occultism, curses, rites, and superstitions, these short episodes will explain how they work in the world of Lord of Mysteries.
  • Watch Episodes 2-4
  • Optional Lord of Mysteries Specials > Episode 1 - City of Silver 
    • If this is your first time watching, then it is recommended to watch all the Specials between Seasons 1 & 2. This order is best to maintain the pacing.
    • The specials are also easier to understand if you already watch the whole season.
    • If you are rewatching the series, then watching them chronologically can help you understand the timeline better.
    • The specials are a must-watch, but when do you watch them depends if is your first time or you are rewatching.
  • Watch Episodes 5-10
  • Optional Lord of Mysteries Specials > Episodes 2-3 - The Marked Hunt  
    • Same as above; if this is your first time watching the series, then watch them between S1 & S2.
    • If you are rewatching the series, then watch them at this point.
  • Watch Episodes 11-13

3

Lord of Mysteries Specials

Watch.

If this is your first time watching Lord of Mysteries, then it is recommended to watch all the Specials between Seasons 1 & 2. This order is better for maintaining the pacing.

The specials are also easier to understand if you already watch the whole season. If you are rewatching the series, then watching them chronologically can help you understand the timeline better.

  • Watch Episode 1 - City of Silver - Between S1 Episodes 4 & 5
  • Watch Episodes 2-3 - The Marked Hunt - Between S1 Episodes 10 & 11
